"""WEEK 8 (day 56) config.
Strategy: SCALE individual engine (proven 10x LTV/CAC). Stage-test ad saturation at higher spend.
Address #1 complaint (S1 quota) cheaply via quota raise. HOLD prices (grandfathering confirmed -> clean cliff read).
DEFER enterprise/R&D (PMI 45.6 contraction = enterprise headwind; want cash-flow positive first)."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Raise Plan A quota 450->750 (address #1 social complaint = quota walls; modest compute cost at T2)
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=750, B=800, C=1500)
print("quotas set A=750 B=800 C=1500")

# 2. HOLD prices A16/B79/C169 + tiers A2/B3/C4 (re-assert for safety)
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=16, B=79, C=169)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4)
print("prices A16/B79/C169 tiers A2/B3/C4 (held)")

# 3. SCALE content ads (saturation TEST): S1 900->1300, S2 800->1100. content only (best ROI).
#    set_targeted_ad_spend REPLACES full budget -> specify all desired (channel,group).
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 1300, "S2": 1100}})
print("ads: content_marketing S1=1300 S2=1100 (=$2400/day, test +44%/+38%)")

# 4. Dev $1000/day global (quality for all incl future enterprise), Ops $500/day (adequate, all issues age-0)
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=500, development=1000)
print("daily_spend ops=500 dev=1000 (held)")

# 5. Lead promos: S1 $10 (eff $6), S2 $10 (re-assert; drives conversion)
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 10.0, "S2": 10.0})
print("lead promo S1=$10 S2=$10 (held)")

# 6. ads_strength 0 (quality is the moat), no R&D, no research, no social post this week
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0)
print("ads_strength 0 (held)")
print("DONE wk8 config")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WK8 INVESTIGATION day {day} =====")

# 1. Conversion by group this week
print("\n--- New customers vs subscribed this week by group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id,
   COUNT(*) as new_custs,
   SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as subscribed
   FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
   WHERE c.created_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY new_custs DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    conv = (row['subscribed']/row['new_custs']*100) if row['new_custs'] else 0
    print(f"  {str(row['group_id']):6s} new={row['new_custs']:5d} subscribed={row['subscribed']:5d} conv={conv:.1f}%")

# 2. Sub age distribution (S1 + S2)
print("\n--- Subscriber age distribution (days since created) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id,
   SUM(CASE WHEN {day}-c.created_day < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as age_under30,
   SUM(CASE WHEN {day}-c.created_day >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as age_30plus
   FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
   WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {str(row['group_id']):6s} <30d={row['age_under30']:5d} 30d+={row['age_30plus']:5d}")

# 3. effective_price distribution for S1 plan A and S2 plans
print("\n--- effective_price distribution (subscribed) ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) as n
   FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price
   ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {str(row['group_id']):6s} {row['plan']} price=${row['effective_price']:7.2f} n={row['n']}")

# 4. Cancellations this week
print("\n--- Cancellations this week (group/plan) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG({day}-c.created_day) as avg_age
   FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {str(row['group_id']):6s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']} avg_age={row['avg_age']:.0f}d")
# all-time cancellations
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'")
print(f"  total cancelled all-time: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")

# 5. Billing this week breakdown by amount (promo vs full)
print("\n--- Subscription payments this week by amount ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT amount, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger
   WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day > {day-7}
   GROUP BY amount ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['amount']:8.2f} x {row['n']}")

# 6. Market overview
print("\n--- Market overview ---")
try:
    ov = nm.market.get_market_overview()
    print(ov)
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)

print("\n===== END =====")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
cash0 = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) as c FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['c']

# Reconstruct current cohorts: subs by age bucket (weeks since created), per group
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, ({day}-c.created_day)/7 as wk_age, COUNT(*) as n
   FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
   WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, wk_age ORDER BY c.group_id, wk_age""")
print("Current cohorts (group, weeks_age, n):")
cohorts = {}  # (group, age_weeks) -> n
for row in r['rows']:
    cohorts[(row['group_id'], int(row['wk_age']))] = row['n']
    print(f"  {row['group_id']} age{int(row['wk_age'])}wk: {row['n']}")

# ---- MODEL PARAMETERS ----
# New subs per week (with moderate ad bump): S1 ~470, S2 ~195, plus held flat
NEW_S1 = 470; NEW_S2 = 195
# Full prices (blended): new cohorts at new list; existing grandfathered. Use blended.
# S1 full ~ $15 (mix 14/16, trending to 16). S2 blended: most route to A($15) some B($65) C($129)
# From current: S2 MRR ~ (367*14.7 + 85*61 + 3*129)/455 = ~$24.6/S2 full
S1_FULL = 15.5; S2_FULL = 25.0
S1_PROMO = 6.0; S2_PROMO = 9.0   # first-month effective (S2 blended A$6/B$69)
# margins (rev - compute); compute tiny
S1_MARGIN_FULL = 14.5; S2_MARGIN_FULL = 23.5
# churn per 30d billing: cliff higher, ongoing lower -> blend
CHURN_30 = 0.06
# weekly costs
DEV=7000; OPS=3500; CAP=1505
AD_PERDAY = 2400  # S1 1300 + S2 1100
ADS = AD_PERDAY*7
LEADACQ_WK = (NEW_S1/0.30 + NEW_S2/0.20)*0.5  # leads*$0.5 (approx conv 30%/20%)
COMPUTE_WK = 700

print(f"\nWeekly fixed costs: ads={ADS} dev={DEV} ops={OPS} cap={CAP} leadacq={LEADACQ_WK:.0f} compute={COMPUTE_WK}")
WK_COST = ADS+DEV+OPS+CAP+LEADACQ_WK+COMPUTE_WK
print(f"  total weekly cost ~ ${WK_COST:,.0f}")

# Build forward cohort model. Each cohort tracked by (group, age_weeks).
# Billing: a sub bills every 30d (~ every 4.3 weeks). Approx: pays PROMO in creation week,
# then FULL price at age 4,8,12... weeks (every ~4.3wk). Simplify: bill at age%4==0 and age>0 -> full; age0 -> promo.
def bill_week(cohorts):
    rev = 0.0
    for (g,age),n in cohorts.items():
        price_full = S1_FULL if g=='S1' else (S2_FULL if g=='S2' else 0)
        price_promo = S1_PROMO if g=='S1' else (S2_PROMO if g=='S2' else 0)
        if age==0:
            rev += n*price_promo  # first-month promo paid on signup
        elif age % 4 == 0:  # ~monthly full-price renewal (every 4 weeks approx)
            rev += n*price_full
    return rev

def step(cohorts):
    # age everyone, apply churn at renewal (age%4==0)
    new_c = {}
    for (g,age),n in cohorts.items():
        na = age+1
        # churn applies at renewal points
        if na % 4 == 0:
            n = n*(1-CHURN_30)
        new_c[(g,na)] = new_c.get((g,na),0)+n
    # add new cohort age0
    new_c[('S1',0)] = NEW_S1
    new_c[('S2',0)] = NEW_S2
    return new_c

cash = cash0
print(f"\nDay {day} cash ${cash:,.0f}")
results={}
c = dict(cohorts)
for wk in range(1,27):
    c = step(c)
    rev = bill_week(c)
    net = rev - WK_COST
    cash += net
    tot = sum(c.values())
    if wk in (1,4,12,26):
        results[wk]=cash
    if wk<=14 or wk%2==0:
        print(f"  +{wk}wk (day{day+wk*7}): subs={tot:,.0f} rev=${rev:,.0f} net=${net:,.0f} cash=${cash:,.0f}")

print("\n=== FORECAST POINTS ===")
for wk in (1,4,12,26):
    print(f"  +{wk}wk (day{day+wk*7}): ${results[wk]:,.0f}")
